verdict.rationale: Bun documents non-interactive dependency management. `bun install`, `bun add`, and `bun update` run without prompts, and interactivity is opt-in via `--interactive`. `--frozen-lockfile` gives reproducible installs, and offline mode states that an uncached required dependency "is an error". The failure-reporting half of the story is barely evidenced: there is no documentation of exit-code semantics or error output formats. missing for 10: documented exit codes, structured/machine-readable error output, explicit CI/non-interactive mode guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven installs.
